outcome.technical: drive-phase.py: new constant SESSION_BUDGET_RULE ('The session is its own process under its own --budget-usd, set by executor.writerBudgetUsd; it is not drawn from this session's budget, so launch the run: line as printed.'), added as a second rule line to the four session dispatch steps (dispatch-writer, resume-writer, dispatch-reviewer-session, dispatch-validation) as a literal tuple (WRITER_RULE, SESSION_BUDGET_RULE) because _refs.followed_anchor_drift reads STEPS as a literal table and resolves names only inside tuples; the signal line is untouched, the sentence prints under the step line and so in --explain. The same sentence, verbatim, follows the 'run it in background Bash' sentence in commands/run.md, next.md, resume.md and review.md (the plan gate allowed the last two, which are outside the declared files but carry the identical dispatch description). tests/test_drive_phase.py (_signal_cases): sn4s counts the sentence in the lines of all four session dispatches (once each) and asserts the Agent dispatch-executor step does not carry it (the always-fires direction); sn4d derives every commands/*.md that says a writer's dispatch is a run: line, requires run.md and next.md among them, and counts the constant's text in each (whitespace-normalised) exactly once. Sweep of tests/test_drive_phase.py, test__refs.py, test__deps.py, test__help.py: exit 0, 4/4 files ok. wait-writer, wait-reviewer-session and wait-validation steps were left unchanged (they point at the same run: line but are not the dispatch). Dependants: tests/test_drive_phase.py - still correct, it is the file extended; PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md, README.md, docs/research/pipeline-cost-design.md - name drive-phase.py and its followed-step table, the README table row for WRITER_RULE steps still resolves (fa1 green, which caught my first draft); hooks/detect-plan-skip.py, record-risk-confirmation.py, stamp-verification.py, _areas.py - reference the script by basename or path only, no printed text changed except extra rule lines on four dispatch steps; names used elsewhere (_clip, _mark, _marked, _carries) untouched. Commands docs dependants: audit-task.py, tests/test__refs.py, test_audit_task.py, tools/measure-context.py (gate run, passes), PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md and docs/research/* cite the command docs by name and are still correct; plugins/audit/reference/verbs-in-full.md names next.md only.
